findings.note: Zach Edey has been ruled out of Friday's game at the Pelicans to manage his left ankle, and Quinten Post is also out with a concussion. That leaves Stewart and Taylor Hendricks next in line for center minutes, which could raise Stewart's playing time and scoring.

Stewart missed two games with a knee injury and was upgraded from questionable to available for 11/11 vs Denver, where he scored 3 points on 1-of-3 shooting in 18 minutes with 5 fouls. He scored 6 in 10 minutes on 11/4, the game he left early, so his health and foul trouble could limit him.

Stewart averages 10.8 points in 18.3 minutes on 64.7% shooting this season, above the 9.5 line. In the 11/2 game against New Orleans he scored 14 points in 28 minutes. He also scored 24 and 18 in late October.
